svg.title: FIX — complete eight-layer channel stage: every deposited line and direction

g.text: FIX — ALL CHANNEL LINES AND DIRECTIONS: LAYERS 11–18
Both loops + all horizontal / diagonal lead-ins on every layer. Arrows on every segment; stars mark channel starts.
Actual nozzle centerlines • K0.05 • channel speed 3 then 5 mm/s • lead-ins 25 mm/s / flow 0.98
Zoom the SVG for the short segments. Hover paths for the original G-code command. Non-extruding transfer travel is omitted.
128 extrusion moves • LEFT clockwise / RIGHT counterclockwise • starts Y123.500
